name_note: GTDB places the Gardnerella species inside the genus Bifidobacterium, so the literature name of s__Bifidobacterium swidsinskii is Gardnerella swidsinskii; some genomes in this GTDB species are labelled Gardnerella vaginalis by NCBI.

sentences.text: Gardnerella swidsinskii was named when whole genome sequence analysis of 81 Gardnerella genomes led to the description of three new species alongside an emended Gardnerella vaginalis.
It is a vaginal bacterium of the genus Gardnerella, whose members are described as initiating and dominating the biofilm on the vaginal epithelium in bacterial vaginosis.

In a sexual health clinic cohort, concentrations and prevalence of every Gardnerella species group tested, including the swidsinskii group, were significantly higher in participants with bacterial vaginosis.
Gardnerella vaginalis is also commonly found in women who are asymptomatic or BV-negative, which raised the question of whether genetic differences distinguish pathogenic from commensal isolates.
